commands_run: cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core role_need 2>&1

policy_denials.detail: git status --short && ls crates/athena-core/src | head -80 && grep -n "OLY-9-11" -A12 docs/spec.toml && sed -n 225,260p crates/athena-core/src/store.rs && sed -n 400,470p crates/athena-core/src/store.rs && grep -n "STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS" -B2 -A30 crates/athena-core/src/status.rs | head -120

python3 -I - <<'EOF'
p='crates/athena-core/src/role_need.rs'
s=open(p).read()
a=s.index("        let mut recs = records(jobs);\n        // Ids are")
b=s.index("        let need = RoleNeed::compute_at(&renamed")
s=s[:a]+"        let recs = records(jobs);\n"+s[b:].replace("&renamed","&recs",1)
s=s.replace("        stub.dispatched_at = None;\n","").replace("let mut stub: athena_data::records::Job","let stub: athena_data::records::Job")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cargo fmt --all && cargo test -p athena-core role_need 2>&1 | tail -40

cargo test -p athena-cli role_need 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |test result|error|warning" ; cargo test -p athena-core every_measure_label 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |error"; cargo test -p xtask --test spec --test policy 2>&1 | grep -E "^test |test result|error|FAIL|panick"

cargo test -p athena-core every_measure_label 2>&1 | grep -c "1 passed" ; cargo test -p xtask --test spec --test policy 2>&1 | grep -E "test result|FAILED|panicked|rejected"; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1 | grep -E "^(warning|error)" ; cargo fmt --all --check && echo fmtok; git status --short
cargo test -p athena-core every_measure_label 2>&1 | tail -n 0; cargo test -p athena-core every_measure_label --lib -- --nocapture 2>&1 | Out-String
cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings 2>&1; cargo fmt --all --check && echo fmtok; git status --short
